headline: Middle East Conflict Drives Global Oil Up 13%, Raising Fuel Costs in Nigeria
summary: Middle East conflict pushed global crude oil prices up 13% this month. The surge is driving up petrol, transportation fares, and food prices in Nigeria.
why: Crude oil is a primary global energy benchmark that directly impacts retail fuel prices, inflation rates, and transport costs worldwide.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Middle East conflict has restricted supply expectations, driving prices up 13%.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Escalating geopolitics in the Middle East disrupted supply expectations, pushing crude oil prices up 13% over the past month.
